title: Georgie Boyd's clarinet style
summary: Old clarinetists carried several clarinets in different keys. Angrum admired Georgie Boyd, who sounded like Dodds and read little, and George Lewis followed him.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
